name: Visual Director Skill
purpose: Rulebook for choosing a render engine per scene (HyperFrames compositor, Three.js in the page, Blender plates), authoring and previewing Blender plates, and compositing them in HyperFrames.
capabilities: Engine decision procedure with treatment vs subject signals and worked examples
Plate authoring with the lab API and four templates (hero-orbit, particle-field, rigid-collapse, light-shafts)
Compositing contract: per-format plates, timed <video>, paint order, alpha, legibility, timing to words

installation.instructions: Workspace file; run by the visual-director subagent (.claude/agents/visual-director.md) or any session.

compatibility.notes: Heavy steps go through visual-director.py render and studio.py build (host lock).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Writes project visual plans, plate scripts and plate markup.

approval_evidence: New on 2026-11-24; exercised on projects/lab-blender-hybrid (Windows host).
